Kiswahili: Ushauri unabainisha uwezekano mkubwa wa mashambulizi ya kigaidi kulenga maeneo ya umma na unahimiza uelewa na kufuata mwongozo wa usalama.
Dholuo: Owacho ni nitie pek mang'eny ma nyalo yudo ji ka gineno ni nitie timbe mahundu e alwora ma ji odakie kendo ojiwo ni ji ong'e kendo oluw puonj ma tayo weche mag sirkal.

English: Parents are urged to enroll children in day secondary school without delay.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanahimizwa kuandikisha watoto katika shule ya upili ya kutwa bila kuchelewa.
Dholuo: Jonyuol okwayo mondo ondiki nyithindgi e skul mar sekondari ma ok odhi nyime.

English: Learn anywhere! Join mobile schools for pastoralist children.
Kiswahili: Jifunze popote! Jiunge na shule zinazotembea za watoto wafugaji.
Dholuo: Puonjri kamoro amora! Dhiuru e skunde mitimoe limbe ne nyithindo modak e gwenge maboyo.

English: Communities facing fire outbreaks should follow school safety protocols issued by county disaster teams.
Kiswahili: Jamii zinazokabiliwa na milipuko ya moto zinapaswa kufuata kanuni za usalama shuleni zilizotolewa na timu za maafa za kaunti.
Dholuo: Oganda maromo gi tuwo mar mach onego oluw chike mag arita mag skul ma ogol gi jokanyo mag masira mag kaunti.

English: Sugary juices and sodas are harmful to babies and increase the risk of obesity and tooth decay.
Kiswahili: Juisi na soda zenye sukari ni hatari kwa watoto wachanga na huongeza hatari ya unene kupita kiasi na kuoza kwa meno.
Dholuo: Juices kod soda ma nigi sukari hinyo nyithindo kendo miyo gibedo gi tuwo mar ng'ich ahinya kod tuoche mag lak.
